workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text: Great news! I found a time that works for everyone: Thursday at 10:00 AM. I have booked it. Please send the confirmation email to all partners.

emails.body: This is a confirmation for the partners' meeting, scheduled for Thursday, November 19 at 10:00 AM Eastern. The meeting will last for 30 minutes. All four partners—Priya Raman, Marcus Hale, Elena Soto, and David Okafor—are scheduled to attend.
